clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau was eating a sandwich at a shared table in a New York deli when a stranger sat down right beside him.

He recognized the man instantly: Bobby Singer, the card-counting guru from late-night TV infomercials. Bobby asked about Kevin's own memory-training business - then said something unexpected: record your workshop, sell it on TV.

Kevin said no, twice. His customers were business professionals - that audience doesn't buy from TV, he said. Bobby didn't back down. He offered to fund the whole production himself for just a royalty. Zero risk to Kevin.

Sometimes the person who sees your opportunity isn't you.
